purpose: Adapters for strict nineteenth-century personal and institutional slide collections recovered through item-level shelf lists, current local-authority collection records, museum audit literature and bounded institutional inventories.
guards: Do not project mixed-period current collection totals wholly into the nineteenth century; isolate pre-1900 objects from explicit labels, dates and maker chronology.
Keep current physical arrangement separate from original provenance where material from one historical collection is intentionally intermixed inside another.
Retrospective modern accession or registration dates document later museum control and must not be substituted for historical object-production or collection-entry dates.
Preserve non-standard early slide dimensions and homemade glass formats rather than normalising them to the later 76 x 26 mm standard.
A named historical user is not automatically the preparer or maker; preserve use, preparation and custody as separate relations.

adapters.institution_scope: Harvard Farlow Herbarium Clarence A. Cheever diatom collection
adapters.target: official Cheever collection page, forty box shelf lists and locality index
adapters.promotion_rule: Harvest box/slide positions, label text, maker, locality and explicit date fields to isolate nineteenth-century slides; retain Terry and other provenance annotations where current Cheever arrangement contains intermixed material.

adapters.institution_scope: East Ayrshire Natural Sciences / Dick Institute James Blackwood collection
adapters.target: current Future Museum collector page plus East Ayrshire collection-development strategy
adapters.promotion_rule: Capture the 1000-slide-to-rock collection relation, Heddle manuscript notebook and Blackwood's pre-1893 collection formation; model post-1901 Dick Institute custody as a separate later museum event.

adapters.institution_scope: National Museums Scotland Charles W. Peach palaeobotanical microscope slides
adapters.target: Geological Curator collection audit and NMS retrospective accession NMS.G.2007.28
adapters.promotion_rule: Treat the thirty 1871 Pettycur slides as a bounded subseries; capture handwritten labels, variable slide formats and accompanying paper documentation while keeping the 1999 microscope acquisition and 2007 retrospective slide registration as separate modern custody/documentation events.

adapters.institution_scope: Science Museum Group historical human-remains/microscope-slide inventory
adapters.target: institutional human-remains inventory entry and collection-search endpoint for Y1996.148.2
adapters.promotion_rule: Preserve object number, date range, Manchester Dental Hospital provenance and use-by relation exactly as catalogued; do not infer maker, slide count or specimen subject until an underlying item record or images provide them.
